integrity: The full-rank spectrum and limiting laws are supported by the analytical matrix-block proof; finite numerical checks only corroborate. All prior classical identities are cited.
scientific_limitations: Applies to integer Chebyshev maps on the invariant arcsine Hilbert space, and not to the Lebesgue-Legendre finite sections of the motivating article. No global historical-priority certification or independent check is claimed.
title: Exact finite-section spectral transitions for Chebyshev iterates
